title: Netflix seasons with the most views in their first 91 days
prompt: Name the 10 most-watched seasons of Netflix series (views in their first 91 days; a series can be in it more than once)

source.name: Wikipedia: List of most-watched Netflix original programming

fact.text: Creator Hwang Dong-hyuk wrote and directed it alone, and the stress cost him six teeth.
Fans recreated Wednesday's dance to Lady Gaga's "Bloody Mary" on TikTok, and Gaga herself joined in.
Rapper T.O.P plays Thanos, a rapper ruined by a crypto scam, voted favorite new player by half of 700,000 fans.
Cate Blanchett appears in its last scene, as the recruiter for an American version of the games.
Each hour-long episode is one continuous take, and each was shot about ten times, two takes a day.
Kate Bush, a fan of the show, let it use "Running Up That Hill", and the song's streams rose over 8,700%.
Its series finale played in cinemas across the US and Canada on New Year's Eve 2025.
It brought in Steve Buscemi as Nevermore's new principal and Joanna Lumley as Grandmama.
Evan Peters wore lead weights on his hands in rehearsals to copy the stiff way Dahmer's arms moved.
Its balls dance to string-quartet covers of pop hits, from "Thank U, Next" to Billie Eilish's "Bad Guy".
